marketing_description: The Leviton R00-GFNT1-00K GFCI outlet features a 15 A amperage rating and self-grounding capability, making it a reliable choice for wall mounting applications. This 2-pole outlet has a NEMA 5-15R rating and includes an LED indicator for added functionality. Constructed with a thermoplastic body and brass contacts, this back wired outlet is designed for durability.
